actors.name: Applicant
actors.private_context: The Applicant submitted a permit application and is waiting for approval. They have no special influence or inside knowledge about the review process.

actors.name: Permit Reviewer
actors.private_context: The Permit Reviewer is responsible for evaluating the application. They have a standard workload and follow established procedures. They are not predisposed to approve or deny.

shared_context: A permit application has been submitted and is pending review. The review process typically takes several weeks. The deadline for approval is the end of August 2026.

starting_events.description: The permit application is in the queue for review.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the permit was approved (i.e., an official approval record is created) on or before 2026-08-31T17:00:00-05:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
